## Bio
I am a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at Mayo Clinic. I received my Ph.D.in Statistics at the Department of Statistics and Data Science at Cornell University under Professor  <a href = 'https://stat.cornell.edu/people/faculty/david-s-matteson'> David S. Matteson</a>. 

My research focuses on Bayesian time-series analysis, uncertainty quantification, and probabilistic forecasting. I also work on interdisciplinary data science problems, with applications in areas including education, precision agriculture and AI measurement.

### Recent Updates
- **Differential Item Functioning as an Item-Level Diagnostic for LLM Benchmarks** (**NeurIPS 2026**)
- <a href="https://openreview.net/pdf?id=dZx0R4Cm8d">**Improving Conditional Coverage in Time-Series Foundation Models via Direct Volatility Modeling**</a> (**ICLR 2026 Workshop on Time Series in the Age of Large Models (TSALM)**)
- <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.11315">**Adaptive Stochastic Volatility (ASV)**</a> (**Journal of Business & Economic Statistics**)
- <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18052">**BASTION**</a> (**AISTATS 2026**)
